question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the process of the manufacture of steel in India?
solution:
The correct answer is** Ginning.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Almost all the steel manufactured today uses 2 processes-**basic oxygen steelmaking and electric arc furnaces.**
 
• This is the** first step in the manufacturing of pure steel.**
 
• In this step,** the raw materials like iron ore, coal, and lime are melted in a blast furnace.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Blast refers to the** combustion air being "forced" or supplied above atmospheric pressure.**
 
• Pig iron, is also** known as crude iron.**
